evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic compression frames an unrehearsed rollback as no rollback at all — urgency-as-worry delivered through a stark, memorable formulation rather than plain alarm.
Neutral summary restating the cadence decision in settled, bureaucratic register — no urgency or affective charge carried over from the original directive.
